title: Keyboard shortcuts
escape: Close a window, a menu or the large code window
linkHere: Copy the address of this page
tab: To the next field, with Shift to the previous one
enter: Apply or save from a single-line field
save: Save a form with multi-line text
note: The keys work on any keyboard layout. While the cursor is in an input field or a window is open, letters type text and start nothing.
